acceptanceCriteria: Aliases are deterministic for a given packet and never persist across packets.
An alias the packet did not issue is dropped or refused, never resolved by guess.
The cited-versus-provided ledger is bounded, local, derived state and is not an input to ranking until V1-0088 admits it through its evaluation gate.
Existing path-and-line citations keep working unchanged.
body: Owner requested this on 2026-09-23 after reviewing Tencent/WeKnora (MIT) as prior art; this ticket records an idea, not delivery or promotion. Original Go work only; no source import. WeKnora is an LLM-at-ingest, database-backed RAG platform, so only the mechanism is borrowed and it must stay deterministic, local and read-only under AGENTS.md invariants 4 and 7. Before implementation is called complete, update the owning indexed spec with stable requirements, non-goals, failure modes, acceptance evidence and rollback, and finish normal CEM/OCM, independent review and mandatory gates. Prior art: website-docs/02-architecture/04-rag-pipeline.md of https://github.com/Tencent/WeKnora. A per-request Registry assigns low-entropy aliases (c1, w2, d3) to retrieved sources, the model must cite with `ref id="cN"` tags, a StreamDecoder expands known aliases back to chunk and document identity after generation and deletes unknown aliases, and the UI receives two separate facts: every source retrieved (a `references` event) and only the sources the model actually cited (inline markers). Current state: task-context packet rows are cited by path and line; nothing in the packet or the adapter distinguishes rows the agent used from rows merely provided, and a fabricated citation is not mechanically rejected. Idea: give each packet row a short stable alias scoped to that packet, let the adapter or CEM binder expand aliases to blob hash plus line range and drop any alias the packet never issued, and record cited versus provided rows in a bounded local ledger. That ledger is a label source for V1-0088 beside the unplanned-read ledger. Owning spec: docs/specs/task-context-packet-v0.md; related: docs/specs/agent-harness-integration-v0.md.
title: context: packet-row citation aliases with fail-closed expansion and a cited-versus-provided ledger
